# sonarqube_qualitygate (Data Source)

Looks up a quality gate and its conditions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_qualitygate" "way" {
  name = "Sonar way"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact gate name.

### Read-Only

- `condition` (Attributes List) Conditions, sorted by metric. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--condition))
- `copy_from` (String) Always null: SonarQube does not record what a gate was copied from. Kept for compatibility.
- `id` (String) The gate name.
- `is_built_in` (Boolean) Whether this gate ships with SonarQube and cannot be changed.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default gate for new projects.

<a id="nestedatt--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `condition`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Condition ID.
- `metric` (String) Metric key the condition checks.
- `op` (String) `LT` or `GT`.
- `threshold` (String) Value that fails the condition when crossed in the direction of `op`.
